name: Eastern Food Services, Inc.
old_description: As one of the region’s premier food service providers, we welcome you to our website, where you can learn more about Eastern Food Services, Inc., and our commitment to providing great service and value to those who entrust us as their food service provider. We carry a wide variety of fresh and frozen foods, paper products, everyday staples, and specialty products to suit our customers’ unique needs. We are here to work with you to make your establishment the best and the most profitable.
about:
Eastern Food Services, Inc. has been headquartered in Laurel, Maryland since its founding in 1984. The privately held company began as a full-line food service distributor and has grown to serve a wide geographic area across the Mid-Atlantic region.

The distributor carries fresh produce, frozen and refrigerated items, canned and dry goods, and paper products. It reports serving more than 300 public school districts and roughly 700 total accounts, supported by delivery fleets, an online ordering platform, and dedicated customer care teams operating from its Maryland locations.

Its customer base centers on K-12 education and broader food service operators, including restaurants, healthcare facilities, and other institutional kitchens. A separate Baltimore division, Eastern Food Baltimore, offers specialty products and extended service hours to meet local demand.

The company states that its differentiation lies in prompt, reliable delivery and high-quality products, with a stated mission to enhance the institutions and communities it serves through exceptional value and service.
